source_name: Ministry of Commerce — Commercial Register (السجل التجاري)
organization: Ministry of Commerce (MoC) / Saudi Business Center
rate_limits: CR inquiry/verification requires Nafath login; inquiry sub-hosts NXDOMAIN/firewalled; no open bulk/API
notes: Official Commercial Register (Ministry of Commerce). The Commercial Register inquiry/verification e-service requires Nafath login (national digital identity). Inquiry sub-hosts (eservices.mc.gov.sa, businesscenter.gov.sa, qaweem.mc.gov.sa) NXDOMAIN/firewalled. No open bulk/API. Identifiers: CR number (10-digit, region prefix), Unified National Number (700...). Managers/owners = personal data (PDPL). Field model from public knowledge; no values copied.

rate_limits: public via browser; HTTP 403 'Access Denied' (WAF) for automation
notes: Saudi Exchange (Tadawul) publishes listed-company profiles, disclosures, and financial statements (issuer directory). Public via browser but WAF-gated ('Access Denied', 403) for automation. Listed companies only (e.g. Saudi Aramco 2222, Al Rajhi Bank 1120, SABIC 2010, STC 7010). Currency SAR.

rate_limits: firewalled (resolves 78.93.109.61, TCP/HTTP timeout) from this environment
notes: National open-data portal (SDAIA). Resolves via DNS (78.93.109.61) but HTTP timed out (firewalled) from this environment; the CKAN API also timed out. No company-register dataset could be confirmed.
